limits: Folders are flat with ordering, not nested hierarchies.
Settings apply on next process launch; an in-flight turn keeps its bound revision.
Shared memory is an unverified note, not scientific fact; CAS protects concurrent edits.
Tool selection changes the registered tool set and does not add a security sandbox beyond the existing runtime.
Recall stops active work, returns the original text, and removes the selected and later turns from future Pi conversation context; prior raw traces remain.
Completed file effects, experiments, sealed submissions and fees are retained.
Deleting a folder moves its sessions to unclassified; restoring the folder does not retroactively reassign moved sessions.
One pre-existing provider TLS EOF request remains UNKNOWN; original budget gate is retained.
